brief.topic: Two Straight Tracks and One Gentle Curve

s01: Two sliders move along straight tracks.
One moves sideways, and the other moves up and down.
A pencil between them begins to draw an ellipse.
The sliders and pencil sit on one rigid bar.
Our pencil is one unit from the horizontal slider and two from the vertical slider.
Those two fixed distances give it two different reaches.
Turn back until the bar is horizontal.
The pencil reaches two units sideways.
Now it reaches only one unit upward.
Continue turning, and those two reaches combine into an ellipse.
The bar keeps its length while both sliders stay on their tracks.
A curved path is growing from two straight constraints.
Now move the pencil to the middle of the same bar.
It is equally far from both sliders.
Both reaches become equal, and the new trace is a circle.
An ellipse and a circle can come from the same quiet motion.

scenes.narration:
Two sliders move along straight tracks. One moves sideways, and the other moves up and down. A pencil between them begins to draw an ellipse.

The sliders and pencil sit on one rigid bar. Our pencil is one unit from the horizontal slider and two from the vertical slider. Those two fixed distances give it two different reaches.

Turn back until the bar is horizontal. The pencil reaches two units sideways. Turn the bar upright. Now it reaches only one unit upward.

Continue turning, and those two reaches combine into an ellipse. The bar keeps its length while both sliders stay on their tracks. A curved path is growing from two straight constraints.

Now move the pencil to the middle of the same bar. It is equally far from both sliders. Both reaches become equal, and the new trace is a circle. An ellipse and a circle can come from the same quiet motion.
